purpose: Define and adversarially rehearse the payload-free backup, restore, and disaster-recovery boundary required before Mythical can depend on autonomous company operating evidence after coordinator, storage, or failure-domain loss. The control binds current A-042 packet, A-046 history, A-047 exception, A-048 lease, A-049 recovery, and A-050 consensus evidence into an exact digest-only manifest; writes, copies, reads back, and restores that manifest in separate operating-system temporary failure-domain directories; detects corruption, truncation, deletion, reordering, stale generations, and unauthorized domains; admits exactly one of four simultaneous restore claimants; blocks activation when global disable is present; and invokes no scheduled company workflow, retains no raw payload or credential, grants no cycle credit, and configures no production backup, restore, durability, or disaster-recovery service.

activationGates.gate: D-017 records the operating cell, backup owner, restore operator, backup, urgent recipient, recovery operator, kill operator, and selected runtime and durability classes
The provider, account, primary and recovery regions, failure domains, storage classes, service objectives, support boundary, and exact all-in cost are selected and approved
Separated least-privilege writer, reader, backup, restore, recovery, kill, alert, key-management, and independent assurance identities are attested and revocable
The exact payload-free backup manifest, source evidence, generation, digest, ordering, completion, retention, immutability, and deletion semantics are approved
Backups are encrypted with approved key ownership, rotation, recovery, revocation, escrow, access logging, and separation from the backed-up storage boundary
Primary and recovery copies use independently reviewed failure domains and cannot share an undocumented account, identity, region, key, quota, operator, or provider dependency
Full and incremental backup, read-back, checksum, record-count, ordering, generation, retention, deletion, and immutability controls are configured and monitored
Corruption, truncation, deletion, reordering, duplication, substitution, stale generation, partial copy, missing key, and conflicting restore are detected and fail closed
Concurrent automated and human restore claimants elect exactly one authenticated holder and every loser remains unable to alter restored state or fencing
Restored lease, fencing, completion, replay, history, alert, disable, identity, policy, and packet state reconcile before any schedule, admission, credit, or effect
Recovery-point and recovery-time objectives are approved, measured from independent evidence, monitored, alerted, and met across complete and partial failures
Global disable, cancellation, identity revocation, budget stops, and complete process-tree kill remain enforceable throughout backup, restore, failover, and reconciliation
A restored environment cannot send alerts, execute packets, grant promotion credit, access credentials, write repositories, dispatch, spend, or act externally before separate admission
Provider outage, account loss, region loss, corruption, quota exhaustion, key loss, alert loss, and operator unavailability exercises pass with measured objectives

Separate expiring approval admits the exact provider, regions, identities, keys, packet and evidence digests, backup, retention, restore, reconciliation, disable, kill, and alert policies
